risks.title: Data lifetime conflicts with user expectations
risks.description: Users may mistake database-backed storage for restart durability even though the MVP is intentionally ephemeral.
risks.mitigation: Document restart loss, use one backend process, test reset behavior, and show the limitation in setup guidance.

risks.title: Privilege escalation through undefined role assignment
risks.description: A defect could allow public sign-up to obtain Manager or Admin privileges.
risks.mitigation: Public sign-up always assigns Recruit server-side; privileged accounts and role changes are Admin-only; test rejected role fields.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-002 and ADR-002

risks.title: Cross-user data exposure
risks.description: Incorrect ownership or assignment checks could expose or mutate another recruit's data.
risks.mitigation: Enforce the documented role/ownership matrix server-side on every endpoint and download using assigned/unassigned fixtures.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-003, Q-004, and ADR-002

risks.title: Inconsistent or untestable validation
risks.description: Frontend and backend validation may drift from the specified field table.
risks.mitigation: Use the section 6 contract as one test matrix and verify backend rejection independently of the UI.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-005, Q-007, and specification section 6

risks.title: Weak or incompatible authentication implementation
risks.description: Authentication defects could expose credentials or leave invalid sessions active.
risks.mitigation: Use the specified PBKDF2 password storage, opaque HttpOnly sessions, eight-hour expiry, logout invalidation, same-origin policy, and negative tests.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-010 and ADR-003

risks.title: Dashboard metrics do not match stakeholder meaning
risks.description: Aggregation implementation may produce incorrect scoped counts, tie ordering, or zero-task progress.
risks.mitigation: Use the exact section 8 formulas and seeded boundary/tie fixtures.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-008 and ADR-004

risks.title: Downloaded reports are incomplete, inconsistent, or leak data
risks.description: Report generation could omit required fields, mishandle inclusive dates, or leak out-of-scope data.
risks.mitigation: Use the section 9 schema, parser-based artifact tests, inclusive boundary fixtures, and shared authorization checks.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-009 and ADR-005

risks.title: Responsive and recovery claims cannot be objectively evaluated
risks.description: Long content or failures may make core flows unusable at the required mobile viewport.
risks.mitigation: Run all core Playwright journeys in current Chromium at 390x844 and 1280x720 with long-content and failure fixtures.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved contract in Q-013 and specification section 10

risks.title: Extension scope causes uncontrolled feature growth
risks.description: Extension work could re-enter MVP generation despite being explicitly deferred.
risks.mitigation: Mark REQ-018/E006/G-H non-MVP and generation-ineligible, exclude G-H from execution waves, and require a separate approved post-MVP revision.
risks.owner_or_decision: Resolved deferral in Q-012 and ADR-006
